You're using Battle Cats GodFat QoL Tools created by vtvz

Here is "documentation" of tags
  • [TOP-1] The best ubers. Spend everything you have to get them
  • [Fest-S] Fest units. Very good and very rare. Should be prioritized. Fest's 'F' tier is 'A' for others
  • [Fest-1] Fest numeric priority. Less is better
  • [Ban-1] Priority within main banner
  • [L-1] Numeric priorities of legend rares. Less is better
  • [S-UT] Tier with Ultra Talents consideration
  • [S-UF] Tier with Ultra Form consideration
  • [S] Extremely overpowered units who excel in their niche and general end game performance. Ubers that typically land around top 30 are placed here
  • [A] Insanely powerful units who only suffer from minor blemishes. Shines above lower tiers either through surpassing generalist expectations or being particularly powerful at their niche
  • [B] Very strong units who are often used as powerful specialists
  • [C] Average units who are sufficient for their usage and offer a well balanced kit
  • [D] Slightly below average units who may struggle in a few of their designated departments. Typically have niche overlaps with a non uber unit or have generic roles
  • [E] Bad units who do not offer value through their niche, usually being outclassed by a handful of non uber options both in niche and generalist aspects. Only spared from F due to very small and situational scenarios
  • [F] Garbage units who have little to no use. Either completely outdone by non uber units or serve zero purpose to exist
  • [NP-SELL] Just sell them for NP
  • [NP-MAYBE] Decide youself to sell for NP or not
  • [NP-A-BIT] Use a bit then sell for NP
  • [NP-STARVE] Use unless NP starve
  • [NP-HALFED] Use until halved / quartered then sell
  • Sell all duplicate Ubers, Legend rares and all Nenekos for NP

  • Data was pulled from the app and event data.
  • Data was completely based on bc-en.yaml.
  • Clicking on the cat's name simulates rolling to that cat.
  • Clicking on 🐾 leads to the cat data.
  • Guaranteed cat will only show if the event has guaranteed cats.
  • Track A or B is purely perspective. Rolling a guaranteed cat will swap the track, not jump. You're always on track A, and the other track is the alternative track.
  • Step-up counts as 15 rolls by summing 3, 5, and 7.
    • Super cats
    • Super in Uberfest or Epicfest only
    • Uber cats
    • Uber in Uberfest or Epicfest only
    • Exclusive cats
    • Found cats
    • Legendary cats if available
    • Priority: Legendary > Found > Exclusive > others
    • Owned cats (original color on the left)
    • Rolled cats
    • Rolled cats with consecutive (11 or 15) rolls
    • Next position after the rolls
  • Prediction of next festival exclusive cats would show if the picked event contains them.
  • Server time is UTC. Event time isn't taken into account yet.
